name: Jeevam Health
long_description:
Jeevam Health (YC S20) is a healthcare app for holistic thyroid treatment.. Even after taking medication, 60% of women are having unresolved symptoms like fatigue, weight issues, and pregnancy challenges. 
Jeevam software assists doctors to diagnose the root cause of dysfunctions & recommend treatment protocol. The treatment revolves around nutrition, supplements, lifestyle changes, and medicine.
one_liner: Digital holistic care for complex chronic conditions

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Currently Heading B2B products at TATA 1mg. Corporate Health & Wellness, Insurance Products & Patient Support Programs for Pharma Companies. 
In my previous work I was, Co-Founder & CEO of Jeevam Health. It's a holistic care App for thyroid treatment. 
Jeevam App assists the user to identify the underlying cause & implement holistic treatment combining food, supplements, lifestyle & medicine. Jeevam Health was backed by Y Combinator, Good Water Capital, Cloud Capital, Dexter Angel
